en-GB.description:
Skill created as a tribute to the mythological Nando Martellone, character of Boris (Italian TV Shows).
Ask Martellone "what do you think" and he will reply with his most famous punch line.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Martellone what does he think about it
en-GB.name: Martellone Boris
en-GB.summary: Ask Boris' Martellone what does he think about stuff. He will reply with his most famous punch line.

it-IT.description: Skill pensata per tutti gli amanti di Nando Martellone, interpretato dal mitico Massimiliano Bruno, nella serie TV Boris.
examplePhrases: Alexa, domanda a Boris Martellone cosa ne pensa
it-IT.name: Martellone Boris
it-IT.summary: Chiedi a Martellone cosa ne pensa, ti risponderà cosa la sua più tipica delle espressioni
